title: ListSchema Grammar
description: The standard structure for a schema describing a data table.

title.description: The title for the list view (e.g., 'All Projects').

columns.description: An ordered array of columns for the data table.

key.description: The key from the data object to display in this column.

label.description: The human-readable header text for the column.

displayAs.description: A hint for the UI on how to format the data.

sortable.description: Whether the UI should allow sorting on this column.
